sections.heading: Ringkasan dan status dukungan
sections.body: Jelaskan masalah yang diselesaikan, pengguna sasaran, batas kemampuan, status rilis, platform yang didukung, dan tautan dokumentasi. Tandai fitur eksperimental dan breaking change secara eksplisit.

sections.heading: Prasyarat dan versi toolchain
sections.body: Catat versi minimum dan versi yang diuji: runtime, package manager, database, container engine, dan CLI. Contoh `engines` serta file versi harus konsisten dengan CI.

sections.heading: Instalasi reproducible
sections.body:
```bash
git clone <repository-url>
cd <repository-directory>
corepack enable
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
cp .env.example .env.local
pnpm dev
``` 
Jelaskan alternatif npm/yarn hanya bila lockfile dan CI mendukungnya. Jangan menyarankan instalasi global yang tidak diperlukan.

sections.heading: Konfigurasi environment
sections.body: Sediakan tabel `VARIABLE | REQUIRED | DEFAULT | DESCRIPTION | SECRET`. Contoh `.env.example` harus berisi placeholder aman, bukan nilai produksi. Validasi variabel wajib pada startup dan dokumentasikan sumber secret per environment.

sections.heading: Perintah harian dan pemeriksaan kualitas
sections.body:
```bash
pnpm lint
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm test:e2e
pnpm build
pnpm start
``` 
Cantumkan expected result, kebutuhan service lokal, fixture, dan cara menjalankan satu test secara terisolasi.

sections.heading: Struktur repository dan alur data
sections.body:
```text
src/
  app/          # route dan UI boundary
  components/   # komponen presentasi
  services/     # integrasi dan business logic
  lib/          # helper murni dan konfigurasi
  tests/        # unit/integration test
docs/           # ADR, runbook, diagram
.github/        # workflow dan template kontribusi
``` 
Sesuaikan daftar dengan struktur aktual dan tunjukkan entry point, migration folder, serta tempat menambahkan fitur.

sections.heading: Deployment, observability, dan recovery
sections.body: Dokumentasikan build artifact, environment target, health endpoint, log/trace/dashboard, proses rollback, backup, dan kontak on-call. Bedakan prosedur lokal, staging, dan produksi.

sections.heading: Lisensi, keamanan, dan dukungan
sections.body: Tuliskan lisensi yang benar-benar dipilih, versi yang didukung, jalur pelaporan vulnerability privat, kebijakan data, dan batas dukungan. Tambahkan link `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `SECURITY.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, dan dokumentasi API bila tersedia.

sections.heading: Branch dan penamaan commit
sections.body:
```bash
git switch main
git pull --ff-only
git switch -c feat/short-description
# atau fix/, docs/, refactor/, chore/
git commit -m "feat(api): add cursor pagination"
``` 
Gunakan format commit yang disepakati: `type(scope): summary`. Hindari commit yang menggabungkan perubahan tidak terkait.

Dokumentasikan perintah yang aktual untuk repository. PR tidak boleh mengklaim test lolos bila tidak dijalankan.

sections.heading: Standar pull request
sections.body:
```markdown
## Ringkasan
## Masalah / issue terkait
## Solusi dan keputusan teknis
## Risiko dan dampak kompatibilitas
## Cara pengujian
## Screenshot / log yang relevan
## Dokumentasi dan changelog
## Checklist
- [ ] Scope terbatasi
- [ ] Test relevan ditambahkan
- [ ] Tidak ada secret atau data pribadi
- [ ] Migration dan rollback dijelaskan
```

sections.heading: Aturan review dan merge
bullets: Minimal reviewer: [jumlah] sesuai CODEOWNERS dan tingkat risiko.
Perubahan auth, permission, billing, schema, atau secret memerlukan reviewer domain terkait.
Semua status check wajib hijau; force-push dilarang setelah approval kecuali perubahan disetujui ulang.
Gunakan squash/rebase/merge commit sesuai kebijakan repository; jangan menghapus diskusi unresolved.
PR besar dipecah menjadi perubahan yang dapat direview secara independen.

sections.heading: Checklist konteks dan scope
bullets: - [ ] Tujuan perubahan sesuai issue/acceptance criteria.
- [ ] Scope tidak mencampur refactor yang tidak terkait.
- [ ] Perilaku lama yang harus dipertahankan sudah diidentifikasi.
- [ ] Feature flag atau staged rollout disiapkan bila risikonya tinggi.

sections.heading: Correctness dan desain
bullets: - [ ] Edge case, null/empty input, timezone, concurrency, retry, dan partial failure diperiksa.
- [ ] Error handling tidak menelan exception atau mengembalikan sukses palsu.
- [ ] Boundary antara controller, domain logic, dan persistence tetap jelas.
- [ ] Tidak ada N+1 query, blocking call, atau operasi mahal di hot path tanpa alasan.
- [ ] Nama, tipe, struktur, dan abstraksi sepadan dengan kompleksitas masalah.

sections.heading: Security dan privasi
bullets: - [ ] AuthN/AuthZ dicek di server, bukan hanya UI.
- [ ] Input divalidasi dan output di-encode sesuai konteks.
- [ ] Tidak ada SQL injection, command injection, SSRF, path traversal, atau insecure deserialization.
- [ ] Secret, token, PII, dan payload sensitif tidak masuk log atau source control.
- [ ] Dependency dan permission baru memiliki alasan dan versi terkunci.

- [ ] Rollback atau mitigasi tersedia dan diuji secara proporsional.
- [ ] README/API docs/runbook/changelog diperbarui.
- [ ] Reviewer memberi approval berdasarkan bukti, bukan hanya jumlah komentar.

sections.heading: Endpoint dan autentikasi
sections.body:
```yaml
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: Service API
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /v1/resources:
    post:
      operationId: createResource
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - in: header
          name: Idempotency-Key
          required: true
          schema: { type: string, minLength: 16, maxLength: 128 }
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/CreateResource' }
      responses:
        '201': { description: Created }
        '400': { description: Validation error }
        '401': { description: Unauthenticated }
        '409': { description: Conflict }
        '429': { description: Rate limited }
``` 
Tambahkan security scheme, scopes, role mapping, dan aturan object-level authorization.

sections.heading: Trigger dan severity
sections.body: Trigger: elevated 5xx, latency p95/p99 melewati SLO, queue backlog, CPU/memory saturation, failed health check, atau dependency outage. Tentukan SEV, impact, paging criteria, commander, dan channel incident.

sections.heading: Triage awal
sections.body:
```bash
kubectl config current-context
kubectl get pods -n <namespace> -o wide
kubectl get deploy -n <namespace>
kubectl get events -n <namespace> --sort-by=.lastTimestamp
kubectl logs deploy/<deployment> -n <namespace> --since=15m
``` 
Pastikan namespace/context benar, ambil snapshot event dan log, catat timestamp UTC, lalu cari perubahan deploy/config terbaru.

sections.heading: Diagnosis dependency dan kapasitas
sections.body: Periksa database connection pool, queue lag, external API status, DNS/TLS, secret/config rotation, autoscaling, node pressure, disk, dan rate limits. Bandingkan dengan baseline dashboard; jangan meningkatkan kapasitas tanpa memeriksa quota dan biaya.

sections.heading: Mitigasi aman
sections.body: Opsi: disable feature flag, shift traffic, scale sesuai batas, circuit-breaker dependency, atau throttle noncritical job. Tentukan approver untuk tindakan berisiko, langkah reversibility, dan komunikasi sebelum eksekusi.

sections.heading: Restart atau rollback
sections.body:
```bash
# Inspect rollout before changing anything
kubectl rollout history deployment/<deployment> -n <namespace>
kubectl rollout status deployment/<deployment> -n <namespace> --timeout=120s

# Roll back only after incident commander approval
kubectl rollout undo deployment/<deployment> -n <namespace>
``` 
Jangan menyalin perintah ke produksi tanpa mengisi resource/namespace yang diverifikasi dan mencatat change ticket.

sections.body:
```bash
curl -fsS https://<health-host>/health/ready
kubectl get pods -n <namespace>
```

sections.body:
```sql
-- EXPAND: additive and backward-compatible
ALTER TABLE accounts
  ADD COLUMN display_name_v2 VARCHAR(160);

-- Deploy code that can read old + new representation.
-- Backfill in bounded batches with checkpointing.
-- CONTRACT only after old code and consumers are retired.
``` 
Ganti SQL dengan migration yang telah diuji pada versi engine dan schema aktual.

sections.heading: Pre-migration checks
bullets: - [ ] Backup terbaru dan restore test berhasil.
- [ ] Migration diuji terhadap copy schema/data representatif.
- [ ] Lock duration, index build, disk headroom, replication lag, dan query plan diperiksa.
- [ ] Writer/reader compatibility untuk versi aplikasi N-1 dan N diuji.
- [ ] Change window, approver, owner database, dan stop condition disepakati.

sections.heading: Prosedur eksekusi
sections.body: Catat migration ID dan checksum; deploy perubahan additive; aktifkan dual-write/read hanya dengan reconciliation; backfill per batch dengan rate limit; verifikasi row count/checksum; alihkan pembacaan; tunggu masa observasi; hapus struktur lama pada rilis terpisah.

sections.heading: Backfill, idempotency, dan data validation
sections.body: Definisikan primary key range, batch size, retry, checkpoint, dead-letter, progress metric, dan resume procedure. Query verifikasi: jumlah row, null rate, duplicate key, referential integrity, sample comparison, dan mismatch threshold.

sections.heading: Rollback dan keputusan stop
sections.body:
```text
STOP jika:
- replication lag > [threshold]
- error rate > [threshold]
- lock wait > [threshold]
- data mismatch > [threshold]
Rollback path:
1. stop backfill / disable feature flag
2. route reads to old column or code path
3. preserve new data for reconciliation
4. restore snapshot only with DBA approval
5. verify write consistency before reopening traffic
``` 
Rollback schema destructive tidak dilakukan bila data baru belum direkonsiliasi.

sections.heading: Post-migration verification
sections.body: Validasi query plan, latency p95, write/read errors, replica lag, constraints, and application compatibility. Simpan migration output, dashboard, approvals, dan hasil reconciliations.

sections.body: Cantumkan operator, approver, backup contact, incident commander, timeline, status keputusan, dan siapa yang mengumumkan keberhasilan. Sign-off dari DBA, service owner, QA, dan product bila perubahan memengaruhi pelanggan.

sections.heading: Pipeline stages
sections.body:
```text
Pull Request
  -> Checkout pinned revision
  -> Install from lockfile
  -> Lint + typecheck
  -> Unit + integration tests
  -> SAST + dependency scan + secret scan
  -> Build immutable artifact
  -> Publish artifact + provenance

Protected main
  -> Promote same artifact to staging
  -> Smoke/contract test
  -> Approval gate
  -> Production canary
  -> Progressive rollout + health checks
```

sections.heading: Contoh workflow GitHub Actions
sections.body:
```yaml
name: CI
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm run typecheck
      - run: npm test -- --run
      - run: npm run build
``` 
Pin action SHA pada repository dengan kebijakan supply-chain ketat dan sesuaikan versi Node/package manager.

sections.heading: Secrets, permissions, dan isolation
bullets: Berikan `permissions` minimum per job; hindari `write-all`.
Gunakan OIDC/short-lived credentials bila platform mendukung; hindari long-lived cloud key.
Jangan expose production secret ke fork PR atau untrusted build.
Pisahkan build/test/deploy identity dan gunakan protected environment approval.
Pin dependency/action, aktifkan lockfile, provenance, SBOM, dan signature bila tersedia.

sections.heading: Artifact dan promotion
sections.body: Build artifact satu kali dari commit immutable; hitung digest/checksum dan deploy artifact yang sama ke staging lalu production. Jangan rebuild dengan dependency berbeda pada tiap environment. Simpan release manifest, commit SHA, image digest, dan migration ID.

sections.heading: Deployment gate dan rollback
bullets: Gate: unit/integration/contract/security scan lolos, migration compatible, approval tercatat.
Canary: [persentase trafik] selama [window], error/latency/saturation harus dalam batas.
Rollback trigger: [threshold] dan decision owner: [role].
Rollback action: redeploy digest sebelumnya atau disable flag; verifikasi data migration terpisah.
Post-deploy: smoke test, synthetic check, dashboard, dan release announcement.

sections.heading: KPI delivery dan pemeliharaan
sections.body: Ukur pipeline duration, queue time, flaky test rate, deployment frequency, change failure rate, rollback duration, dan build reproducibility. Review pipeline setelah perubahan runtime, action, permission, atau platform.

sections.heading: Data flow dan trust boundary
sections.body:
```mermaid
flowchart LR
  User -->|HTTPS| Edge[CDN / WAF]
  Edge --> API[API Service]
  API --> DB[(Database)]
  API --> Queue[(Queue)]
  Queue --> Worker[Worker]
  Worker --> Vendor[External Provider]
  Admin --> Control[Admin Plane]
``` 
Tandai boundary internet/internal, tenant, privileged plane, cloud account, third party, and sensitive data movement.

sections.heading: Threat enumeration STRIDE
bullets: **S - Spoofing:** session/token theft, forged service identity, credential stuffing.
**T - Tampering:** request/body manipulation, stored data modification, package or pipeline tampering.
**R - Repudiation:** insufficient audit trail, mutable logs, missing actor attribution.
**I - Information Disclosure:** IDOR, excessive response fields, logs/secrets exposure, insecure backup.
**D - Denial of Service:** expensive query, queue flood, resource exhaustion, dependency saturation.
**E - Elevation of Privilege:** broken role checks, confused deputy, unsafe admin workflow, IAM over-permission.

sections.heading: Attack path dan risk scoring
sections.body: Untuk tiap threat tulis entry point, precondition, attacker capability, asset, likelihood, impact, exploitability, existing control, residual risk, evidence, dan owner. Gunakan skala serta matrix yang disepakati, jangan menyajikan skor tanpa metodologi.

sections.heading: Mitigation dan verification
sections.body:
```text
Threat: Cross-tenant object access
Control: server-side tenant authorization on every lookup
Test: negative test with tenant-A token requesting tenant-B object
Evidence: integration test + audit event + policy review
Owner: service team
``` 
Mitigasi dapat berupa authz, validation, rate limit, segmentation, encryption, logging, secure defaults, and operational controls.

sections.heading: Abuse cases dan security test
sections.body: Turunkan threat menjadi test case negatif: privilege escalation, replay, injection, IDOR, path traversal, SSRF, race condition, enumeration, and resource abuse. Tentukan test owner, environment aman, acceptance criterion, dan retest date.

sections.heading: Risk acceptance dan residual risk

sections.heading: Strategi flag dan default
sections.body:
```yaml
feature_flags:
  checkout_v2:
    type: release
    default: false
    owner: <team>
    expires_at: <YYYY-MM-DD>
    kill_switch: true
    targeting:
      allow_internal: true
      percentage: 0
``` 
Pastikan default aman saat flag service unavailable dan tentukan server-side evaluation untuk fitur sensitif.

sections.heading: Cohort dan progressive stages
bullets: Stage 0: internal users/test tenants 0%.
Stage 1: canary 1-5% dengan observasi minimal [window].
Stage 2: 10-25%, cek metric dan support signal.
Stage 3: 50%, validasi kapasitas dan segment fairness.
Stage 4: 100% setelah gate dipenuhi dan approver menyetujui.
Jangan memakai targeting berbasis data sensitif tanpa dasar dan review privasi.

sections.heading: Metric gate dan abort threshold
sections.body: Tentukan baseline dan threshold: error rate, latency p95/p99, business conversion, crash rate, support tickets, resource saturation, data mismatch. Metrik harus memiliki source, evaluation window, minimum sample, dan siapa yang mengambil keputusan.

sections.heading: Kill switch dan rollback
sections.body: Dokumentasikan siapa boleh mematikan flag, command/API resmi, fallback behavior, dampak data, race condition, dan verifikasi setelah flag dimatikan. Simpan langkah rollback yang aman; mematikan flag tidak selalu membalikkan migration atau side effect.

sections.heading: Test matrix
sections.body:
```markdown
- [ ] Flag OFF path
- [ ] Flag ON path
- [ ] Evaluation timeout / provider unavailable
- [ ] Mixed cohort and tenant isolation
- [ ] Old client / old schema compatibility
- [ ] Kill switch during active traffic
- [ ] Metrics and audit log
```

sections.heading: Eksperimen dan evaluasi
sections.body: Jika flag dipakai eksperimen, tetapkan hypothesis, primary/guardrail metrics, randomization unit, sample size, duration, stopping rule, dan analisis bias. Pisahkan eksperimen dari flag operasional.

sections.heading: Cleanup dan penutupan
